text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif
text.tspan: Qualified and trained teachers in primary education
Share of teachers who meet the minimum academic qualifications required in the subject they teach at that
level in a given country (qualified) and teachers who have received at least the minimum organized pedagogical
training required for teaching at that level (trained) in primary education, shown as a percentage of all teachers

tspan.tspan: UNESCO Institute for Statistics (2026); UNESCO UIS Data API, via World Bank (2026)
